text.p: WCE canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0850 CDT, according to analysts.

CANOLA - C$0.50 to C$1.00 higher a tonne on CBOT soybean calls, large NOPA crush numbers with the trade waiting for the COPA crush statistics Friday. July WCE futures crush profit margin rose to -16.32 Thursday from -17.46 Wednesday. New-crop canola should find support reflecting reduced acreage expectations to the level of early forecasts of 12.1 to 12.2 million acres compared to prior trade expectations of 13.5 to 14.0. Speculation should soon turn to April 30 Statistics Canada March seeding intentions report.
New-crop canola technical resistance seen at C$380/tonne.
Canadian dollar opened down at C$1.4009 and fell against Japan's yen at 89.85 from 90.02.
FLAX - Steady to C$0.50 up on spill over support.
WESTERN BARLEY - Steady to C$0.50 up on CBOT corn calls with light farmer selling expected along with commercial position rolling from May to July and commercial new-crop demand.
FEED WHEAT - Steady to C$0.50 up on slow farmer selling, watching U.S. corn values, May-July should continue to be bid at C$2.50.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
